item.text: Каталог пуст, поэтому создаю минимальный проект с CLI и README с нуля. В реализации сразу закладываю детерминированность для топологического порядка, циклов и выбора критического пути.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/cli.ts; sed -n '1,220p' README.md; command -v bun; bun --version; tmpdir="'$(mktemp -d); printf '"'%s\\n' '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"deploy\",\"duration\":2,\"dependsOn\":[\"build\"]},{\"id\":\"lint\",\"duration\":1},{\"id\":\"test\",\"duration\":4,\"dependsOn\":[\"lint\"]},{\"id\":\"build\",\"duration\":3,\"dependsOn\":[\"lint\"]}]}' > \""'$tmpdir/main.json"; printf '"'%s\\n' '{\"tasks\":[]}' > \""'$tmpdir/empty.json"; printf '"'%s\\n' '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":0},{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":0,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\"]}]}' > \""'$tmpdir/zero.json"; printf '"'%s\\n' '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"z\",\"duration\":2},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1},{\"id\":\"x\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"z\"]},{\"id\":\"y\",\"duration\":2,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\"]}]}' > \""'$tmpdir/tie.json"; printf '"'%s\\n' '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"c\"]},{\"id\":\"c\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"b\"]},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\"]}]}' > \""'$tmpdir/cycle.json"; bun run src/cli.ts plan "$tmpdir/main.json"; bun run src/cli.ts plan "$tmpdir/empty.json"; bun run src/cli.ts plan "$tmpdir/zero.json"; bun run src/cli.ts plan "$tmpdir/tie.json"; bun run src/cli.ts plan "$tmpdir/cycle.json" 2>&1; test $? -ne 0; bun run src/cli.ts nope "$tmpdir/main.json" 2>&1; test $? -ne 0; bun run src/cli.ts plan "$tmpdir/main.json" --bad 2>&1; test $? -ne 0'
